name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell product page (spec table)
notes: NVIDIA product page spec table, retrieved 2026-10-15. Two columns share one bandwidth and power row: RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell is 48 GB GDDR7 with ECC; RTX PRO 5000 72GB Blackwell is 72 GB GDDR7 with ECC. Shared printed figures: NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, AI TOPS 2064 (sparsity footnote NOT printed on this page — do not assume dense or sparse), Memory Bandwidth 1,344 GB/sec, Max Power Consumption 300 W, 4x DisplayPort 2.1, form factor 4.4in H x 10.5in L dual slot, active thermal. The linked datasheet PDF (workstation-datasheet-blackwell-rtx-pro-5000-5488550, CreateDate 2026-07-22) is image-compressed and did not yield a text layer to this client, so CUDA-core count, bus width, and the FP32 row are NOT taken from it. 384-bit and 14,080 CUDA cores appear in Hardware Corner analysis (Allan Witt, 2025-05-11) and are consistent with 28 Gbps GDDR7 x 384 / 8 = 1,344 GB/s, but they are secondary and not stored as vendor fields.
